title: Set Your Mind
firstLine: Composer; Dusty Owens, arr. by M. Garrett

lines: Composer; Dusty Owens, arr. by M. Garrett
Where on earth may joy be found?
In the midst of sinfulness?
In God's word the truth abounds;
He provides the rest;
If you have been raise with Christ,
Seek the things in heaven's realm,
Only follow God's advice;
He will lead you home.
This old world has naught for you,
With its sorrow, pain and sin,
You have died to sin, be true;
You are hid in Him.
rist shall come to claim His own,
In the midst of toil and strife,
Crowned with glory we'll be home;
He will give us life.
Set your mind on things above,
Not on all that's here below;
Keep your heart in Spirit's love
And the blessings He'll bestow.
